messages.author: ecf19e9eac4d03c4
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: PCA for environment variables
parts: If you have missing data then try missMDA, which can do PCA-based imputation (including regularized and multiple imputation).  Also, check out its "sister" package FactoMineR.
